definition: a huge feeling of wonder at something
description: Filmed on a selfie stick, a young man in glasses and a rust-coloured corduroy shirt leans over a museum display case of old coins, sketching them into a small notebook. He then walks through a picture gallery hung with gold-framed paintings, mouth falling open as he looks around. In the great hall he stops under an enormous mounted skeleton, tips his head right back and stares up at it open-mouthed, holding his notebook up, while a line of schoolchildren files past behind him.

taps.phrase: to hang from the glass roof

en.question: What is the man staring at?

de.answer: Er starrt ein riesiges Skelett an.

es.answer: Está mirando fijamente un esqueleto enorme.

fr.answer: Il fixe du regard un énorme squelette.
